messages:
Ana G.: Hey team — tiny onboarding calendar chaos: I subscribed to the onboarding calendar feed but my phone keeps showing the event at the old time (11:00 PT) while desktop shows 14:00 PT. Anyone else see a mismatch?

DevEx Sam: Ugh, thanks for flagging. We pushed an updated calendar subscription (uses proper TZ IDs now). Mobile apps sometimes cache the feed. Quick steps: unsubscribe, force-refresh, then re-subscribe. On iOS: Settings > Calendar > Accounts > Refresh Calendars. Android: open calendar app > settings > refresh.

IT Crispin: For corporate-managed devices: if the subscription was provisioned via MDM, the old feed can persist until MDM pushes the new profile. If you're on a managed device DM me and I'll force an update.

Marta P.: Another question — will recordings have captions? I rely on captions for accessibility.

DevEx Sam: Yes — recordings get auto-captioned (English) and we run a quick pass to correct obvious errors before publishing. If you need ASL interpretation for the live session, let us know 48h in advance and we can schedule a signer for the EMEA repeat.

Ana G.: Great, thanks. Also my calendar reminders on mobile are only 5 min by default. Any recommended settings for cross-TZ folks?

DevEx Sam: Recommended: Email reminder 24h, Calendar reminder 1h, Device reminder 15m. On most mobile clients you can set event-specific reminders after adding the event.

Marta P.: If someone misses the live Q&A, is there an edited clip of the Q&A or just the full recording?

DevEx Sam: We post the full recording within ~30–60m, plus a short Q&A highlights clip (5-7m) within 24h. Links get posted in #new-hires and the onboarding drive.

calendar-bot: New canonical feed published: https://calendar.redwood.com/ical/new-hires-2026.ics

IT Crispin: If you want me to check your subscription mapping, DM me your email and timezone and I'll confirm. Also, for anyone importing manually, here's a tiny iCal snippet you can save as .ics and import if your client ignores the feed:

Ana G.: Thanks all  unsubscribed and re-synced, now shows correctly on phone. Appreciate the ASL option info.

Marta P.: Perfect. I'll sign up for the EMEA repeat and request ASL for our new hire who asked.

DevEx Sam: Thanks! Posting pinned links and captions policy in the invite description now.
